description: Defines the AppNotificationsImplementation class which manages app notifications, subscriptions, event dispatching, and related utilities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes nested classes for subscriber management, event handling, and notification emission.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notifications and configuration interfaces, managing subscriptions, event dispatching, and notification emission.

classes.name: SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscribers, their notifications, and dispatches events to them.

classes.name: ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles subscription and unsubscription to Thunder module events, and manages notification registration.

classes.name: SubscriberJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for subscribing or unsubscribing to notifications.

classes.name: Emitter
classes.description: Implements the IEmitter interface to emit notifications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an app notification with given context, module, and event.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits an event with payload and appId.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications for a specific connection ID and origin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell.
